## Voice Receptionist 1/3 - Live Call Server (Vapi tool server)
One webhook = Vapi **Server URL**. Routes `tool-calls` (check availability, book, find, reschedule, cancel, request callback), `assistant-request` (caller recognition from Zoho, 7.5s budget) and `end-of-call-report` (acked instantly, forwarded to workflow 2).

**Resilience:** every Google Calendar call retries 3x; on failure the caller still gets a graceful answer. Bookings fall back to **request mode** (saved to `Pending_Bookings`, retried by workflow 3) + throttled alert email. Re-booking is idempotent (deterministic event IDs). Reschedule/cancel require the caller's phone to match the event. SMS confirmation falls back to email. Post-call forward failure saves a raw report + alert.

**Setup:** edit business config in 'Load Config'; connect Calendar, Sheets, Gmail, Zoho, Twilio (HTTP Basic: SID/Token), header-auth secret; set the pipeline URL in 'Forward To Post-Call'; set Error Workflow in Settings.
